Thanks for the demo this morning — it was helpful. A few quick follow-ups from our side as we pull together an internal recommendation:

- Can you send a one-page summary of Redwood's data retention guarantees and how logs are exposed for audits? Our legal team specifically asked about retention windows and the process to produce audit logs.
- Who is the security contact on your side for a short exchange about SOC 2 scope and pen test cadence?

We are targeting an internal decision by the end of May.

Thanks,

Hi Alice / team — following up on the pricing piece. High level ballpark for 25M tokens / month:

- Hosted API (mix of gpt-3.5-like models + embeddings where relevant): ~$0.022 per 1k tokens effective after volume discounts => ~$550 / month nominal but depends on prompt/response ratio.
- Recommended: Redwood Dedicated (reserved capacity) for predictability: estimate $10k–$15k/month for a minimal pool that meets your latency SLOs and 99.9% throughput headroom. Exact sizing requires a short load profile call.

If procurement prefers unit pricing, we can produce a 3-line item price sheet (hosted vs dedicated vs hybrid) and a sample MRR curve. I can have that in your inbox by EOD Apr 24.

Question for procurement: will Orchid require a SOC 2 attestation copy (full report) in addition to the SOC 2 summary? We typically provide a redacted attestation under NDA.

Thanks,
Rishi Malhotra
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Alice Wong <alice.wong@orchidhealth.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 23 Apr 2029 16:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Evidence bundle for Orchid Health — SOC 2, pen test notes, sample logs

Forwarding the evidence bundle from our security team. Summary below plus attached stubs.

Summary of items provided
- SOC2-Summary.pdf — one-page summary of scope (security + availability controls), date of last audit (2028-11), and contact process to request a redacted attestation under NDA.
- pen-test-abstract.txt — high-level scope and remediation status for last third-party test (2028-09); low/med findings remediated; no critical findings. Full report available under NDA and a mutual redaction process.
- audit-log-sample.csv — example of event log export with user, request_id, timestamp, action, resource. All PII redacted in sample.
- ORCH-MAP-v1.xlsx — first draft mutual action plan (MAP) with owners and dates (please review and edit).

Notes on data retention and audit log production
- Default retention windows: request metadata and KV-cache logs retained 90 days in hosted; Dedicated customers can configure retention up to 2 years depending on storage commitment.
- Audit log exports: we can produce a CSV export within 72 hours of request for standard queries; expedited 24-hour exports available with an SLA addendum.

Attachments (stubs): SOC2-Summary.pdf, pen-test-abstract.txt, audit-log-sample.csv, ORCH-MAP-v1.xlsx

If Orchid can sign the NDA, security can provide the redacted SOC 2 and the full pen-test report for procurement review. Happy to jump on a 20-min call to walk through the MAP and delivery timeline.

—
Marissa Cole
Security & Compliance Liaison | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
